test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four of the following five pairs follow a similar letter-coding pattern. Identify the one that does not belong to the group.

CRUSH: XIFHS

BLAST: YOZHG

FROWN: UILDM

HAPPY: SMNMB

SNAIL: HMZRO

Question: Which of the following pairs is the odd one out?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

CRUSH: XIFHS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02d56a4898e41120e5929ae68204eda3bc8a3223b9a6362b18e90908c652ff01.png] 

BLAST: YOZHG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09dea6f782d2996e35af0f99344f5849ba9bdcb66387141d0aea1a58b185c7bf.png] 

FROWN: UILDM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae5dca50d48cb1d0acbfcf14a8527663bce5564b1252f615dafca4339c7b3ad3.png] 

HAPPY: SMNMB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2083bb41b93768e7dd22f985e9978710e58b0664f8159ceabca7116462f445fe.png] 

SNAIL: HMZRO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7e23502ed792778a291aadfcb593e34ddf2f408cc423f1802d3124491a53427.png] 

Thus, out of all "HAPPY: SMNMB" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
